title: Trust Region Constrained Bayesian Optimization with Penalized Constraint Handling
abstract: arXiv:2603.24567v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Constrained optimization in high-dimensional black-box settings is difficult due to expensive evaluations, the lack of gradient information, and complex feasibility regions. In this work, we propose a Bayesian optimization method that combines a penalty formulation, a surrogate model, and a trust region strategy. The constrained problem is converted to an unconstrained form by penalizing constraint violations, which provides a unified modeling framework. A trust region restricts the search to a local region around the current best solution, which improves stability and efficiency in high dimensions. Within this region, we use the Expected Improvement acquisition function to select evaluation points by balancing improvement and uncertainty. translated_title: 带惩罚约束处理的信任域约束贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.24567v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：在高维黑箱设置下的约束优化因昂贵的评估、缺乏梯度信息以及复杂的可行域而变得困难。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种结合惩罚公式、代理模型和信任域策略的贝叶斯优化方法。通过惩罚约束违规将约束问题转化为无约束形式，这提供了一个统一的建模框架。信任域将搜索限制在当前最佳解周围的局部区域，从而在高维中提高稳定性和效率。在该区域内，我们使用期望改进采集函数来选择评估点，以平衡改进和不确定性。所提出的信任域方法将基于惩罚的约束处理与局部代理建模相结合。这种组合能够高效探索可行区域，同时保持...
tldr: 本文提出一种结合惩罚约束处理与信任域策略的贝叶斯优化方法，通过局部搜索和期望改进函数，在高维黑箱约束优化中实现高效且稳定的可行域探索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian optimization method combining penalty-based constraint handling with a trust region strategy, enabling efficient and stable exploration of feasible regions in high-dimensional black-box constrained optimization via local search and Expected Improvement.
